name: Staff of Hoarding
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 297
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 297
Aura moderate varies CL 11th
Slot none; Price 55,866 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This gorgeous teak shaft has many gold and silver coins hammered into it. It allows use of the following spells:
Identify (1 charge)
Locate object (1 charge)
Magic aura (1 charge)
Secret chest (2 charges)
Legend lore (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, identify, legend lore, locate object, magic aura, secret chest; Cost 30,016 gp
